description: List the fiscal years this server has rule packs for, with filing deadlines for the current assessment year and `status`: computed from today's date in India, which deadlines have passed, the days left, the phase per ITR form (on time, belated with the s.234F fee, or updated return only), the revised-return window, and the next advance tax instalment of the current financial year. Quote `status` instead of comparing dates yourself. `statutes` gives each year's Act and, for tax year 2026-27 under the Income-tax Act 2025, the map from the 1961 section numbers the notes cite.

asOf.description: Date to report the status for (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today in India; pass it only to plan ahead.
